classification.difficultyReason: Apply the side definitions relative to the marked theta and read the three given lengths; the tilted diagram does not add a substantive decision.

content.prompt: For the triangle opposite, relative to the reference angle $\theta$, what is the length of:

spec.description: Tilted 5–12–13 triangle: short left edge slopes down to the right; upper long edge rises slightly to the right; theta is at lower left. Source blue becomes black.
spec.mathematics: Perpendicular sides 5 cm and 12 cm; hypotenuse 13 cm; theta lies between the 5 cm and 13 cm sides.
spec.answerVisibility: All three lengths and theta visible; no side classifications supplied.

answer.worked: The side opposite the right angle is the hypotenuse, so its length is $13\text{ cm}$.
The side opposite $\theta$ has length $12\text{ cm}$.
The side next to $\theta$, excluding the hypotenuse, has length $5\text{ cm}$.
